title: Honest feedback..
author: Ok_Performance9384
selftext:
Hey everyone,
I’ve been building something completely on my own and really need honest feedback. 

This is not an ad  I don’t have anyone to try it or give real opinions. Even small feedback would mean a lot. 

The Reddit community has been super helpful in the past, which is why I’m posting here.

The game is CourtArena (CourtArena.site). It’s completely free, supports 9 languages, and you can play as a guest with no registration.


The first is a criminal investigation game inspired by physical detective box games, but fully interactive. You get a cinematic investigation board to organize suspects, evidence, crime scene photos, forensic diagrams, police reports, and more.

 Interrogation is central. you can question suspects directly, by voice or messages, with personality responses and heart rate lie detection. 
New questions unlock as you uncover links, and you can even call witnesses, the former officer, or the forensic examiner. Play fully open or guided with an AI assistant. 

At the end, you accuse someone and write a report. The AI evaluates your reasoning and reveals the true story.


The second is a courtroom simulation. Pick a case or create your own. Three roles: judge, plaintiff lawyer, and defense lawyer. Present evidence, object, interrogate witnesses, make closing arguments, and get a verdict. The AI evaluates each player individually.
Playable solo or online with friends via a shared link. Works on laptop, tablet, or mobile.

Building this alone has been exhausting, so any honest feedback truly helps. If anyone wants to try it and share their thoughts, please reach out. I’ll make sure you have everything you need.
